findings.finding: The request asks for photos but the checkout has only one clearly relevant team image plus rider portraits; external sourcing could add attribution and licensing scope.
findings.resolution: Use existing local assets only and treat additional photo sourcing as out of scope unless separately authorized.

findings.finding: Allowing the mobile root route without auth must not expose private ride APIs or make private routes reachable.
findings.resolution: Gate only the root landing route; keep the existing private route redirects and token-gated rider APIs.

findings.finding: A static template change alone would not prove the rider-detail symptom is fixed.
findings.resolution: Add a focused client contract/render regression and run a real mobile/browser flow where available.

reviewed_claims: Web anonymous/authenticated split is achievable with existing session context and cache key separation.
Mobile anonymous root access can be isolated in the current Expo Router auth gate.
The public rider API already has a brevet-only server contract and tests.
